findings.description: それがいいんじゃない endorses Bern declaring in red, with naive dreamers given as the reason. Are you sure instead questions that choice and turns the dreamers into a possible reason for caution.

MG.japanese: 「それがいいんじゃない？　まだ甘い夢を見てる魔女どもも、いるみたいだし」
MG.translation: "Are you sure? There might still be some witches with naive hopes."

UP.japanese: 「それがいいんじゃない？　まだ甘い夢を見てる魔女どもも、いるみたいだし」

findings.sourceReading: Would that not be a good idea? There still seem to be witches dreaming naive dreams.
findings.alternative: Lambda subsequently explicitly says Go on and say it, restoring her encouragement and limiting the reversal to this turn.

findings.description: MG writes a incredibly rather than an incredibly

contexts.japanese: 私を最高に楽しませる、最高に残虐な物語を紡がせてあげるわ。
contexts.japanesePS3: 私を最高に楽しませる、最高に残虐な物語を紡がせてあげるわ。
contexts.MG: I'm gonna have you spin a incredibly brutal tale that I'll find incredibly entertaining.
contexts.UP: I'm going to have you spin a truly brutal tale to truly entertain me.

MG.japanese: 「さぁ、ベアトのゲーム盤の駒たち……？　私を最高に楽しませる、最高に残虐な物語を紡がせてあげるわ。慄きなさい、約束された絶対の運命を。……奇跡の魔女、ベルンカステルの名において。……そして、ベアトのゲームの、最後のゲームマスターとして宣言するわ」「……ただ宣言するだけじゃつまらないわね。……ベアトのゲームに則って、赤き真実で宣言してやった方がいいかしら？」
MG.translation: "Hey, pieces of Beato's game...? I'm gonna have you spin a incredibly brutal tale that I'll find incredibly entertaining. Tremble in fear of the certain fate you've been promised. ...By the name of Bernkastel, Witch of Miracles, ...and as the final Game Master of Beato's game, I proclaim it." "...Though just saying it would be boring. ...Maybe I should follow Beato's rules and say it in red."

UP.japanese: 「さぁ、ベアトのゲーム盤の駒たち……？　私を最高に楽しませる、最高に残虐な物語を紡がせてあげるわ。慄きなさい、約束された絶対の運命を。……奇跡の魔女、ベルンカステルの名において。……そして、ベアトのゲームの、最後のゲームマスターとして宣言するわ」「……ただ宣言するだけじゃつまらないわね。……ベアトのゲームに則って、赤き真実で宣言してやった方がいいかしら？」
UP.translation: "Now, pieces of Beato's game......? I'm going to have you spin a truly brutal tale to truly entertain me. Tremble with fear of the absolute fate you have been promised. ......By the name of Bernkastel, Witch of Miracles, ......and as the final Game Master of Beato's game, I proclaim it." "......Though just saying it would be boring. ......Maybe I should follow Beato's rules and say it in red."

findings.sourceReading: The adjective begins with a vowel sound and requires an; original PC261126 has grammatical a truly, as does UP.
findings.alternative: Meaning is clear; article error only.
